description: Swap the nullish-coalescing operator for logical-or, so a falsy-but-defined value (0, '', false) that must survive is silently replaced by the fallback.
Widen a strict less-than bound to less-than-or-equal, introducing an off-by-one that admits one extra element/index.
Widen a strict greater-than bound to greater-than-or-equal, introducing an off-by-one on the upper edge of a range check.
Drop a leading `await`, turning an awaited promise into a fire-and-forget call whose result/rejection is silently discarded.
Neuter a null/undefined guard (`if (x == null) return` / `if (!x) return`) by rewriting the condition to always-false, so the guard never fires.
Swap logical AND for logical OR, flipping a conjunctive condition into a disjunctive one.
Invert a strict-equality check to strict-inequality, flipping the branch the condition takes.
Remove a leading auth-guard call (`.auth(...)`/`requireAuth(...)`) from the line, so the request proceeds unauthenticated.
Strip a `path.join(root, ...)` wrapper down to the raw joined argument, dropping the root-confinement it provided and opening a path-traversal hole.
